name: operator_frame_recertification
authorised_by: user decision dec-90857c24085565bb (write the live hash into metadata)
trigger: operator_metadata.json pinned frame_manifest_sha256=25b77f5d (written 2026-08-12) while the live frame_manifest.json hashed to a89d36a5 (regenerated 2026-09-15 when the LPR cohort was built), so every V4 path depended on allow_stale_frame_manifest: true.

why_not_a_content_error.finding: The live and the certified manifests are content-identical; only JSON field order differs.
why_not_a_content_error.only_difference: voxel_grid_gt is serialized before version/frame_contract/fem_mesh in the live file and after them in the certified file
why_not_a_content_error.consequence: No geometric, semantic or ordering change; the hash drift is serialization-only.

highlights.mesh_discretization_pin: mesh.npz sha256 equals the certified mesh_sha256 (always enforced)
highlights.geometry_round_trip: manifest grid/spacing/offset -> flat index -> world coords reproduces the cached coords_world with max deviation 1.526e-06 mm
highlights.projection_operator: P shape (1677645, 19990), nnz 6710580, exactly 4 P1 entries per row, row sums = 1.0, all entries non-negative
highlights.dimensional_agreement: mesh nodes 19990 = A columns; A rows 7413 = surface nodes = measurement length
highlights.forward_ordering_pin: d1q frozen contract measurement_b == max(A @ gt_nodes, 0) reproduces with worst relative L2 1.709e-07 over 4 cases, pinning the A column order to the mesh node order and the row order to the measurement order
highlights.view_indexing: 7 angles [-90,-60,-30,0,30,60,90]; volume centre equals half the extent

verification.enforcement_proof: CanonicalCrossDiscretization now loads with both pins ENFORCED (no allow_stale): PASS
verification.negative_control: a deliberately wrong frame_manifest pin is rejected with a RuntimeError, confirming the check is not silently skipped
verification.smoke_run: scripts/audit_lpr_negativity_layers.py --max-samples 4 runs end to end with enforcement active
verification.note: mesh_sha256 was already correct and is unchanged; it remains the primary discretization anchor.

known_leftovers: 12 further configs under configs/stage2/ still pin the old hash 25b77f5d (unified_dual_evidence_fem_v4_2400.yaml, scale_calibrated_proximal_fem_v3_2400.yaml, iterative_residual_aware_fem_2400.yaml, error_structured_cross_discretization_2400.yaml, residual_consistent_iterative_fem_v2_2400.yaml, cqr_v2_3k_*.yaml, stage1_hard_q*.yaml, falsification/*.yaml). They are not on the current LPR path and were already inconsistent; they were deliberately left untouched.

scripts/recover_certified_frame_manifest.py can still reconstruct the 25b77f5d serialization byte-exactly from mesh.npz. It is retained as a recovery tool; running it with --restore would revert this certification.
Historical artefacts under results/ and runs/ embed the old hash in their own config snapshots. They are immutable run records and must not be rewritten.
not_authorised: Any regeneration of MCX data, GT, splits, or the operator cache.
